# YouTube triggers

## API quota exhausted

Runs when Cuebot has used up your daily YouTube limit (quota). YouTube then blocks most requests until the limit resets.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%resumesAt%` | When YouTube lets Cuebot continue |
| `%quotaUsed%` | How much of the limit was used today |

<small>Type id: `youtube.quotaExceeded`</small>

## Broadcast added (scheduled)

Runs when you schedule a new YouTube live stream. Cuebot notices it a few minutes later.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastTitle%` | The stream title |
| `%broadcastId%` | ID of the stream |
| `%broadcastScheduledStart%` | When it is planned to start |
| `%broadcastUrl%` | Web link to the stream |

<small>Type id: `youtube.broadcastAdded`</small>

## Broadcast ended

Runs when your YouTube live stream ends. Handy for a goodbye message.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastTitle%` | Your stream title |
| `%broadcastId%` | ID of the stream |
| `%broadcastActualEnd%` | When it ended |

<small>Type id: `youtube.broadcastEnded`</small>

## Broadcast monitoring ended

Runs when Cuebot stops watching a YouTube stream's chat, because it ended or you disconnected.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastTitle%` | The stream title |
| `%broadcastId%` | ID of the stream |

<small>Type id: `youtube.broadcastMonitoringEnded`</small>

## Broadcast monitoring started

Runs when Cuebot starts watching a YouTube stream's chat (it finds a live stream, or you connect during one). It is not the same as going live.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastTitle%` | The stream title |
| `%broadcastId%` | ID of the stream |

<small>Type id: `youtube.broadcastMonitoringStarted`</small>

## Broadcast removed

Runs when a scheduled YouTube live stream is deleted or cancelled before it started.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastTitle%` | The stream title |
| `%broadcastId%` | ID of the stream |

<small>Type id: `youtube.broadcastRemoved`</small>

## Broadcast started

Runs when your YouTube live stream goes live. Use it to say hello, switch scenes or reset counters.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastTitle%` | Your stream title |
| `%broadcastId%` | ID of the stream |
| `%broadcastUrl%` | Web link to the stream |
| `%broadcastActualStart%` | When it went live |

<small>Type id: `youtube.broadcastStarted`</small>

## Broadcast statistics updated

Runs each time Cuebot reads the numbers of your live YouTube stream (about once a minute). Use it to react to viewer counts.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum concurrent viewers** | Only run when at least this many people watch right now. 0 runs every time. Example: 100. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%concurrentViewers%` | How many people watch right now |
| `%viewCount%` | Total views |
| `%likeCount%` | Likes |
| `%commentCount%` | Comments |
| `%broadcastTitle%` | The stream title |

<small>Type id: `youtube.broadcastStatisticsUpdated`</small>

## Broadcast updated

Runs when the title, description or privacy of your YouTube stream changes.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%broadcastTitle%` | The new title |
| `%previousTitle%` | The title before |
| `%broadcastDescription%` | The new description |
| `%broadcastPrivacy%` | public, unlisted or private |
| `%previousPrivacy%` | The privacy before |

<small>Type id: `youtube.broadcastUpdated`</small>

## Chat message

Runs when someone writes in your YouTube live chat. Handy for replies or word triggers.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Message contains** | Only run when the message has this text in it, like "hello". Capital letters do not matter. Leave empty to run for every message. |
| **Ignore the bot account** | Tick to skip messages written by your own bot account, so it does not react to itself. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the person who wrote |
| `%userId%` | Their YouTube channel ID |
| `%message%` | What they wrote |
| `%messageId%` | ID of the message |
| `%isModerator%` | True if they are a moderator |
| `%isMember%` | True if they are a channel member |
| `%isBroadcaster%` | True if it is you |

<small>Type id: `youtube.chatMessage`</small>

## Gift membership received

Runs for each person who receives a gifted membership. Good for welcoming the new member.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Membership level contains** | Only run for membership levels whose name has this text in it, like "Gold". Empty runs for every level. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the person who received it |
| `%userId%` | Their YouTube channel ID |
| `%gifterName%` | Name of the person who gifted it |
| `%levelName%` | Name of the membership level |

<small>Type id: `youtube.giftMembershipReceived`</small>

## Jewels gifted

Runs when a viewer sends Jewels (YouTube's gifts for vertical live streams).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum jewels** | Only run when at least this many Jewels were sent. 0 runs for every gift. Example: 50. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the sender |
| `%jewels%` | How many Jewels |
| `%giftName%` | Name of the gift |
| `%comboCount%` | How many times in a row (a combo) |
| `%message%` | The text that came with it |

<small>Type id: `youtube.jewelsGifted`</small>

## Member milestone

Runs when a member shares their milestone message, for example "12 months" of membership. Good for a thank-you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Membership level contains** | Only run for membership levels whose name has this text in it, like "Gold". Empty runs for every level. |
| **Minimum months** | Only run when the member has been with you at least this many months. 0 runs for every milestone. Example: 6. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the member |
| `%months%` | How many months they have been a member |
| `%levelName%` | Name of the membership level |
| `%message%` | The message they wrote with it |

<small>Type id: `youtube.memberMilestone`</small>

## Members-only mode ended

Runs when members-only chat is turned off, so everyone can write again.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%moderator%` | Who turned it off |

<small>Type id: `youtube.sponsorOnlyEnded`</small>

## Members-only mode started

Runs when members-only chat is turned on, so only your channel members can write.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%moderator%` | Who turned it on |

<small>Type id: `youtube.sponsorOnlyStarted`</small>

## Membership gift

Runs when someone buys memberships as gifts for others. It runs once for the gifter. Use it to thank them for the whole gift.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Membership level contains** | Only run for membership levels whose name has this text in it, like "Gold". Empty runs for every level. |
| **Minimum gifted** | Only run when at least this many memberships were gifted. Example: 5. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the gifter |
| `%userId%` | Their YouTube channel ID |
| `%total%` | How many memberships were gifted |
| `%levelName%` | Name of the membership level |

<small>Type id: `youtube.membershipGift`</small>

## Message deleted

Runs when a message is deleted from your YouTube live chat.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%messageId%` | ID of the deleted message |
| `%targetUser%` | Name of the person who wrote it, if Cuebot saw it |
| `%targetMessage%` | What it said, if Cuebot saw it |
| `%moderator%` | Who deleted it |

<small>Type id: `youtube.messageDeleted`</small>

## New member (sponsor)

Runs when someone becomes a new member of your YouTube channel (YouTube calls members "sponsors"). Good for a thank-you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Membership level contains** | Only run for membership levels whose name has this text in it, like "Gold". Empty runs for every level. |
| **Upgrades** | "Only upgrades" runs only when a member moves up to a higher level. "No upgrades" runs only for brand-new members. "Any" runs for both. Options: Any, Only upgrades, No upgrades. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the new member |
| `%userId%` | Their YouTube channel ID |
| `%levelName%` | Name of the membership level |
| `%isUpgrade%` | True if they upgraded from a lower level |
| `%message%` | YouTube's message about it |

<small>Type id: `youtube.newSponsor`</small>

## New subscriber

Runs when someone subscribes to your YouTube channel. Cuebot checks every few minutes and can only see people whose subscriptions are public.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the new subscriber |
| `%userId%` | Their YouTube channel ID |
| `%channelUrl%` | Web link to their channel |
| `%subscribedAt%` | When they subscribed |

<small>Type id: `youtube.newSubscriber`</small>

## Super Chat

Runs when a viewer pays for a Super Chat (a highlighted paid message). Good for a thank-you or an alert.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | Only run for at least this much money, in the currency the viewer paid in. 0 means no minimum. Example: 5. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | Only run for at most this much money. 0 means no maximum. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currency (ISO code, empty = any)** | Only run for this currency, as a 3-letter code like "USD" or "EUR". Empty runs for any currency. |
| **Minimum tier** | Only run for this level or higher. YouTube gives each Super Chat a color level from 1 (lowest) up. 0 runs for every level. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the sender |
| `%amount%` | How much was paid, as a number |
| `%currency%` | Currency code, like USD |
| `%amountText%` | The amount as YouTube shows it, like $5.00 |
| `%tier%` | The Super Chat color level |
| `%message%` | The text that came with it |

<small>Type id: `youtube.superChat`</small>

## Super Sticker

Runs when a viewer pays for a Super Sticker (a paid picture in chat). Good for a thank-you or an alert.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | Only run for at least this much money, in the currency the viewer paid in. 0 means no minimum. Example: 2. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | Only run for at most this much money. 0 means no maximum. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currency (ISO code, empty = any)** | Only run for this currency, as a 3-letter code like "USD" or "EUR". Empty runs for any currency. |
| **Minimum tier** | Only run for this level or higher. YouTube gives each Super Sticker a color level from 1 (lowest) up. 0 runs for every level. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the sender |
| `%amount%` | How much was paid, as a number |
| `%currency%` | Currency code, like USD |
| `%amountText%` | The amount as YouTube shows it |
| `%tier%` | The color level |
| `%stickerAltText%` | A text describing the sticker |

<small>Type id: `youtube.superSticker`</small>

## User banned

Runs when someone is banned from your YouTube live chat.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the banned person |
| `%userId%` | Their YouTube channel ID |
| `%moderator%` | Who banned them |
| `%banType%` | permanent or temporary |

<small>Type id: `youtube.userBanned`</small>

## User timed out

Runs when someone gets a timeout (a short mute) in your YouTube live chat.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum duration (seconds)** | Only run when the timeout is at least this many seconds. 0 runs for every timeout. Example: 300. Starts as: `0`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Name of the person |
| `%userId%` | Their YouTube channel ID |
| `%moderator%` | Who gave the timeout |
| `%duration%` | Length of the timeout in seconds |

<small>Type id: `youtube.userTimedOut`</small>
